image_description: The image displays two traffic light units suspended against a cloudy sky and a modern building facade. The primary subject is a vertical traffic light on the left, showing an illuminated red signal at the top, with unlit amber and green signals below. It features distinct visors over each lens and is mounted via a bracket to overhead wires. A secondary, smaller horizontal traffic light is visible in the lower right background, appearing yellowish/tan. Overhead utility wires crisscross the upper portion of the frame.
